ownership_rule: User rules 2026-09-25/26: the project owns this database; no application (Ingest, Media Assist, Story or any other) owns it or its tables. No form writes to it, so none can own it: data made in an application reaches these tables only through the one intermediary of the project database (qnc.module.db-broker), whose table module qnc.module.virtual-shots owns this table (lego split of the former content store, 2026-09-26).
